notes: KTEL buses run from Fira (Oia 20 min, Perissa 30 min, 2 EUR). ATVs and scooters cost 25-40 EUR a day, and taxis are scarce (25-40 EUR). Buses serve the airport and Athinios port.

Summer temperatures are 28-33°C with the meltemi wind (strong in July and August). Oia's 20:30 sunset is very crowded (arrive an hour early). Fira is packed on cruise ship days (leave before 14:00). August is the most expensive month.
Akrotiri 12 EUR, Thera 6, volcano tour 30-50, catamaran 120+, wine tasting 20-30. Caldera restaurants cost 30-50, Perissa 15-20. Round up the bill for a tip.
Fava (yellow split pea purée), tomatokeftedes, chlorotyri cheese, white aubergine, Assyrtiko and Vinsanto. Santorini tomatoes are tiny.
Do the caldera hike at 7-8 in the morning (in summer). Don't ride the donkeys. Luggage can't be carried in Oia (steps), so stay in Fira or Imerovigli.
The hot springs stain swimwear, and Red Beach has a rockfall warning.

stops.name: Fira Caldera Walking Path
stops.tips: Fira's caldera edge: white cubes, blue domes and the volcano across the water.

stops.name: Museum of Prehistoric Thera
stops.tips: Akrotiri frescoes (the Blue Monkeys). Small but essential.

stops.name: Fira Catholic Cathedral & Streets
stops.tips: White and yellow cathedral, Gold Street shops, and donkeys (don't ride them).

stops.name: Argo Restaurant Fira
stops.tips: Caldera views, with fish and fava (yellow split pea purée).

stops.name: Fira Sunset Cable Car & Old Port
stops.tips: Take the cable car (6 EUR) down to the old port for the lights of the ships. Return by cable car or climb the 588 steps.

backups.name: Lucky's Souvlakis Fira
backups.tips: Cheap gyros, instead of caldera prices.

backups.name: Santozeum / Megaro Gyzi
backups.tips: Photos of the 1956 earthquake in the Gyzi Mansion. A museum alternative.

stops.name: Skaros Rock
stops.tips: One hour from Fira along the caldera path (set off at 07:00 in summer). The Venetian castle rock below Imerovigli has the best view and is free.

stops.name: Imerovigli–Oia Trail
stops.tips: Profitis Ilias chapel and a ridge of volcanic rock, then the descent into Oia. Carry 1.5 litres of water.

stops.name: Melitini Oia
stops.tips: Oia's meze restaurant for lunch, with a sea-view terrace.

stops.name: Ammoudi Bay
stops.tips: A fishing cove 300 steps below Oia. Swim off the rocks and eat at the Ammoudi tavernas.

stops.name: Oia Castle
stops.tips: The ruins of Agios Nikolaos castle and a world-famous sunset. Grab a spot an hour early (or book a restaurant). It's crowded, with a bus back.

backups.name: Sunset Ammoudi Taverna
backups.tips: Grilled octopus down in the bay at Ammoudi.

backups.name: Atlantis Books Oia
backups.tips: A cave-like bookshop, instead of the bay.

stops.name: Nea Kameni Volcano Boat
stops.tips: Boat from the old port (tours 30-50 EUR) to the volcanic island.

stops.name: Nea Kameni Crater Walk
stops.tips: A black lava path climbs 130 m to the crater, with sulphur fumes. Park fee 5 EUR.

stops.name: Palea Kameni Hot Springs
stops.tips: Jump off the boat and swim to the muddy 35°C water (wear a dark swimsuit).

stops.name: Thirassia Island Lunch
stops.tips: A quiet island across the caldera. Eat at a taverna in Korfos village (if included in your tour), with steps up to Manolas.

stops.name: Back to Oia via Ammoudi
stops.tips: The boat returns to Ammoudi or Fira.

backups.name: Catamaran Caldera Tour
backups.tips: A catamaran to Red Beach, White Beach and the hot springs, with food and drinks included. An alternative to the volcano tour (afternoon sunset version).

backups.name: To Psaraki Vlychada
backups.tips: Fish at Vlychada harbour, if you're not on a tour.

stops.name: Akrotiri Archaeological Site
stops.tips: The Minoan Pompeii of 1600 BC, with three-storey houses preserved under ash. Roofed, so go in the morning.

stops.name: Red Beach
stops.tips: A beach below red cliffs, with a rockfall warning. Look from the top and swim briefly.

stops.name: Akrotiri Lighthouse
stops.tips: An 1892 lighthouse at the island's southwestern tip, with views.

stops.name: The Cave of Nikolas Akrotiri
stops.tips: A beach taverna at Akrotiri. Try tomatokeftedes (tomato fritters) and fava.

stops.name: Vlychada Beach
stops.tips: A rocky beach with a moonscape view. Quiet, next to the Tomato Industrial Museum.

backups.name: Tomato Industrial Museum Vlychada
backups.tips: A tomato paste factory from 1945, and the story of Santorini's tiny tomato.

backups.name: Dolphins Akrotiri Beach Taverna
backups.tips: A wooden taverna over the water.

stops.name: Pyrgos Village & Kastelli
stops.tips: The island's highest village, with a Venetian castle quarter and 360° views. Few tourists.

stops.name: Santo Wines Pyrgos
stops.tips: A cooperative with caldera views. Taste Assyrtiko and Vinsanto (6 wines), with meze.

stops.name: Megalochori
stops.tips: A quiet village with a bell tower, wine cellars and a square.

stops.name: Venetsanos Winery
stops.tips: A 1947 winery carved into the cliff. Go early, before sunset.

stops.name: Domaine Sigalas Oia
stops.tips: The island's best Assyrtiko, with tastings and cheese in the vineyard.

backups.name: Art Space Winery Exo Gonia
backups.tips: An art gallery in a cave winery, instead of Venetsanos.

backups.name: Metaxy Mas Exo Gonia
backups.tips: A favourite taverna with locals. Book ahead. An alternative to Santo.

days.theme: East coast beaches: Perissa and Kamari

stops.name: Ancient Thera
stops.tips: A Dorian-Roman city on Mesa Vouno mountain. A zigzag road from Kamari (taxi or scooter) leads to the agora and the sea.

stops.name: Perissa Black Beach
stops.tips: 7 km of black sand, with sunbeds, shallow water and water sports.

stops.name: Perivolos Tranquilo Beach Bar
stops.tips: A sustainable beach bar serving couscous and burgers.

stops.name: Kamari Beach
stops.tips: Across the mountain from Perissa. A promenade and black pebbles, plus an open-air cinema (summer).

stops.name: Kamari Open Air Cinema
stops.tips: Films and cocktails in a garden (May-October).

backups.name: Monastery Kamari
backups.tips: A restaurant in a monastery courtyard in Kamari.

backups.name: Eleftherios Venizelos Museum Kamari
backups.tips: A small museum, for rainy days instead of the beach.

stops.name: Mezzo Imerovigli
stops.tips: Breakfast with caldera views. Quiet in the morning, with Greek yoghurt and honey.

stops.name: Anastasi Church Imerovigli
stops.tips: A blue dome and bell. Visit after breakfast.

stops.name: Fira Factory Shop
stops.tips: Souvenirs: Vinsanto, capers, fava and volcanic stone, in Fira.

stops.name: Santorini Airport
stops.tips: 20 minutes by bus from Fira, or 25 EUR by taxi. Time to say goodbye (30 minutes to Athinios port if leaving by ferry).

backups.name: Mama's House Fira
backups.tips: A legendary cheap, huge breakfast near the Fira bus station.

backups.name: Skaros Morning Walk
backups.tips: Back to the rock, instead of souvenir shopping.
